# Miss Pembroke

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Miss Pembroke has keen dark eyes. Her cheek is wrinkled.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

Miss Pembroke is an elderly lady who exhibits a somewhat self-centered demeanor. Despite this trait, she proves to be exceptionally welcoming and offers splendid entertainment to her guests.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Traits

- somewhat self-centered  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- welcoming  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026)</sub>

## History

Miss Pembroke was a self-centered old lady who had rarely held affection for anyone other than herself and had never engaged in mischievous antics during her youth. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) regularly visited her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) while balancing her academic life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Later, Miss Pembroke sent a twenty-dollar willowware platter with a note urging [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to handle it with great caution, though the platter was subsequently smashed by [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) during a lunch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P85](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0085), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011), +5 more_

## Relationships

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harcourt--miss-pembroke.md)

[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) is a close friend of Miss Pembroke, becoming a frequent visitor and favorite companion at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). Their bond is established early on and remains a constant part of Miss Pembroke's social life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

- Friend of — frequent visitor and favorite companion at Beechwood  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/miss-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a strong friendship with Miss Pembroke, frequently visiting her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) while balancing her academic life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Their relationship involves shared social moments, though it experiences occasional awkwardness, such as when [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally smashes Miss Pembroke's platter during a gathering, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic for the mishap.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), +9 more_

- Friend of — strong friendship formed between them  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV.
